description:
Standing approvals cover every step. Window ~2-3 hours.
1. Stop enqueueing; let in-flight merge groups finish or clear the queue (clearing is acceptable; PRs re-enqueue after).
2. One API call on ruleset develop-squash-only (15611785): remove required ci-required-result, Results Explorer browser gate, ruleset-drift, Public-site visual acceptance; add core, explorer, results-data, docs, landing, tooling; queue builds 2, timeout 60. Doing it in one call avoids the old drift check deadlocking. This also freezes the queue naturally: PRs without ci.yml results cannot enqueue.
3. Open the flip PR from dlv2-f1's branch (if not already open), confirm its ci.yml checks are green, enqueue, and watch it merge.
4. Watch 3 more real PRs merge green under the new checks (update/enqueue green dev-loop or other PRs).
5. Unfreeze: update the remaining open PRs' branches about 5 at a time (gh pr update-branch) so they get ci.yml results without stampeding runners.
Rollback if step 3 or 4 fails in a way not fixable in minutes: restore the saved ruleset JSON, merge the prepared revert (it restores the old workflows and passes under them), record the cause, STOP.
